author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Build your own custom app with AI - no coding required! In this step-by-step Jotform AI App Builder tutorial, you'll learn how to create a fully functional app from a simple prompt. Whether you're building an inventory management app, customer portal, employee onboarding app, project tracker, or event registration system, Jotform AI App Builder can generate it for you in minutes. 🔗 Try Jotform AI App Builder: https://jotformapp.kevinstratvert.com 

In this video, you'll learn how to:
• Create an app using a simple AI prompt
• Build apps from PDFs, websites, images, or voice input
• Customize your app using AI
• Edit your app manually with drag-and-drop tools
• Change themes, layouts, branding, and colors
• Add charts, dashboards, forms, and other app components
• Manage your app's data and records
• Enable AI chatbot functionality
• Publish your app and share it with users
• Embed your app into your website
• Manage user permissions and roles
